get.description:
Modeled single-service capacity from reported resources.

A resource-based estimate under demo requirement profiles, not confirmed spare
admission capacity. Unknown capacity is a successful result, not an error.

Modeled single-service capacity for every facility offering the service.

An unknown service_id returns 200 with service_name null and no facilities.
Estimates are demo resource-based models, not spare admission capacity.

Seven-day modeled capacity and demand forecast for one facility service.

Insufficient history is a successful result with status insufficient_history.
Predicted gaps are not calibrated shortage probabilities. Synthetic demo data.

post.description: Save a draft. A draft is not an operational approval.

Confirm reviewed inputs and capture the baseline atomically. Do not auto-retry;
a repeated or concurrent confirmation returns 409 with the existing revision.
201 with a new saved run, or 200 with the run already saved for this revision.

Solve and save a transfer proposal from a saved simulation's frozen scenario.
Needs-inputs, no-improvement and no-solution outcomes are saved results too.

get.description: The saved proposal as computed; reopening never re-solves.
Versioned synthetic starter catalog. Requests carry their own reviewed copy.

post.description:
Select and save a funding package from a saved allocation proposal's frozen
post-transfer state. Every outcome, including no improvement, is saved.

get.description: The saved proposal as computed; reopening never re-solves or reloads the catalog.

post.description: Record a draft decision for a validated saved proposal. Freezes its expectation.

Apply one command. 201 when applied; 200 returns the saved result of a retried
request_id. Outdated expected_version is 409.

Capture current reports and compare them with the frozen expectation. The
capture time is the server's; reopening returns this review unchanged.

get.description: Process liveness only; does not assert database or AI availability.

AllocationRun.title: AllocationRun
AllocationRun.description: Saved proposal. Reopening returns this record; it is never re-solved.

AppliedResourceOverride.title: AppliedResourceOverride
AppliedResourceOverride.description: Scenario quantity is a planner assumption, not a reported observation.

DecisionEvent.title: DecisionEvent
DecisionEvent.description:
Append-only timeline entry. recorded_at is server time; occurred_at is the
human-reported time, when the event has one.

FacilityConstraint.title: FacilityConstraint
FacilityConstraint.description:
Planner-confirmed limits for one facility. transferable_quantity is explicitly
approved movable inventory, not all reported equipment.

ForecastAlert.title: ForecastAlert
ForecastAlert.description: A predicted gap; not a calibrated shortage probability.

ForecastValidation.title: ForecastValidation
ForecastValidation.description: Error on withheld historical days, in simultaneous service places.

IncidentInput.title: IncidentInput
IncidentInput.description: Confirmed input: same shape, with the selection and start time required.

InvestmentCandidate.title: InvestmentCandidate
InvestmentCandidate.description:
A supplied, human-reviewed project. Costs and times are estimates, never
generated by the optimizer. Missing confirmation makes it ineligible.

InvestmentCatalog.title: InvestmentCatalog
InvestmentCatalog.description: Versioned starter catalog; a request copies and may edit it run-locally.

InvestmentRun.title: InvestmentRun
InvestmentRun.description: Saved funding proposal. Reopening returns this record; it is never re-solved.

InvestmentSummary.title: InvestmentSummary
InvestmentSummary.description: Totals over included facilities only at evaluation_at.

NetworkServiceListResponse.title: NetworkServiceListResponse
NetworkServiceListResponse.description: Services offered by at least one facility, ordered by service_id.

OutcomeReview.title: OutcomeReview
OutcomeReview.description: Captured follow-up review. Reopening returns it; later reports create a new one.

PlanSummary.title: PlanSummary
PlanSummary.description: Totals over included facilities only; excluded demand is not counted as zero.

ResourceOverride.title: ResourceOverride
ResourceOverride.description: Absolute scenario availability, not a loss to subtract. Zero is explicit zero.

RouteConstraint.title: RouteConstraint
RouteConstraint.description: An explicitly approved directed route; coordinates never imply one.

ServiceRequirement.title: ServiceRequirement
ServiceRequirement.description: Configurable requirement profile; demo values are not clinical standards.

SourceExpectation.title: SourceExpectation
SourceExpectation.description: Frozen at decision creation from the saved source run; never recomputed.
